To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the nutritional state of the cows in early lactation influences the conception rates after Ovulation Synchronization/Fixed-Time Artificial Insemination (OvSYNCH/FTAI) and the postparturient ovarian cyclicity and that the conception rates decrease in cows with delayed postparturient cyclicity.

the nutritional state of the peripartum cows was associated with the postpartum recovery of ovarian function, the conception rates after synchronization/fixed-time AI and also suggested the interval from calving to first ovulation influenced the conception rates.
the nutritional state of dairy cows in peripartum is associated with the recovery rate of ovarian function and also with conception rates after synchronization and fixed-time artificial Insemination.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nutritional state in peripartum cows and the recovery of ovarian cyclical activity and conception rates after OVYCH/TAI.
the nutritional state of peripartum cows and the conception rate of cows after OVYNCH/TAI.
the effects of the nutritional state in peripartum cows on the postpartum recovery of ovarian function, conception rates after OVYSNCH/TA and the interval from calving to first ovulation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the BCS of cows peripatrum was associated with postpartum ovarian function and conception after synchronization of ovulations.
cows with a BSC of 2.5-3.25 had a higher conception rates after OVYSNCH/TAi and also a higher proportion of cows established ovarian cyclicity before day 55 postpartum.
the nutritional state of the cows periparturient is important to the recovery of the ovarian function and the conception rates after synchronization protocols and fixed-time artificial breeding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nutritional state peripartum is an important factor influencing conception rates and postpartum ovarian function in cows.

cows with BCS of < or =2 at calving or 30 d postcalving and cows which recovered ovarian activity > or =56 days after calving had a lower conception rate than those with a higher BCS and those which recovered ovarian activity within 34 days after calving.

the nutritional state peripartum affected the recovery of ovarian cyclical function and conception rates in cows after OVSYCH/TAI, and the interval from calving to first ovulation was an important factor in the conception rates after synchronization and fixed-time artificial breeding.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the recovery of ovarian cyclical function is a critical determinant of the success of the synchronization of ovulation protocol and the conception rates after fixed-time artificial inseminations in dairy cows.
the nutritional state of the cows peripartal is important for conception rate after synchronization of ovulations and fixed-time artificial-insemination.

body condition score (or nutritional status) of cows peripatrum has a significant effect on the onset of ovarian cyclicity and on conception rates after ovulaton synchronization/fixed-time AI (OVSYN/TAI).
